findings.span: простой Text Switch и переключатель LoRA
findings.suggestion: простой Text Switch и LoRA Switch
findings.reason: Inconsistent handling of parallel terms: 'Text Switch' is kept in English while 'LoRA Switch' is partially translated, though both are the same kind of label in the source.
Adds 'рядом' (side-by-side), which is not present in the English source.
'style LoRA' (a LoRA that adds a style) is rendered as 'стиль LoRA', which reads as 'the style of LoRA' and distorts the meaning.
Literal rendering of 'vs' as 'против' is awkward here and inconsistent with 'A или B' used in the same sentence for the same construction.
Transliteration 'свитч' is inconsistent with 'переключатель' used everywhere else in the entry.
Plural 'Nodes' must be rendered as 'Узлы' per the UI glossary; the same sentence already uses 'комбинацию узлов', creating an inconsistency within one paragraph.
Plural 'nodes' should be 'узлы' per glossary (Nodes → Узлы), and it is inconsistent with 'узлов' used in the extended description.

Quotation style is inconsistent within the page: the extendedDescription and howToUse use Russian guillemets («») for node names while the FAQ uses straight single quotes.
'product images' should use the glossary term 'изображение' rather than 'фото'.
